name: @waste/api
description: The Hono API: the only web boundary to domain data (ADR-0001). GET /healthz (liveness), GET /readyz (readiness: the database answers within two seconds, or 503), GET /openapi.json (OpenAPI 3.1 through hono-openapi), an environment parsed once at startup, DATABASE_URL required. Connects as the API role through @waste/db; no auth yet. Runs TypeScript source through tsx, like every workspace package, until hosting decides on bundling.
